sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: WITH THE LARGE SCALE PATTERN REMAINING LARGELY UNCHANGED...WESTERN STATES TROUGH/SPLIT UPPER FLOW WILL PERSIST OVER THE WESTERN CONUS. PRIMARY SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL EJECT NORTHEASTWARD FROM THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST/NORTHERN ROCKIES TO THE MT HIGH PLAINS/SOUTHERN SASKATCHEWAN VICINITY BY EARLY TUESDAY. IN ADDITION...MULTIPLE LOW AMPLITUDE/CONVECTIVELY INDUCED DISTURBANCES WILL SPREAD EAST-NORTHEASTWARD WITHIN A BELT OF WSW FLOW ALOFT FROM THE GREAT BASIN/ROCKIES TO THE NORTHERN PLAINS/GREAT LAKES VICINITY.

sections.title: MIDWEST
sections.text: MULTIPLE MCS/S OR AT LEAST ASSOCIATED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM REMNANTS /OUTFLOW AND PERHAPS ONE OR MORE MCVS/ WILL BE ONGOING EARLY IN THE PERIOD ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST/MIDDLE MS VALLEY VICINITY. AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY...AMPLE DAYTIME DESTABILIZATION IS PROBABLE ACROSS THE MIDWEST/OH RIVER VALLEY...INCLUDING IL/INDIANA AND PORTIONS OF OH/SOUTHERN LOWER MI. WITH THE REGION ON THE SOUTHERN PERIPHERY OF MODERATELY STRONG FLOW ALOFT...MULTICELLULAR/LINEAR EASTWARD-MOVING CLUSTERS WILL LIKELY BE THE DOMINANT CONVECTIVE MODE...WITH DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY HAZARD ASIDE FROM SOME MARGINAL HAIL POTENTIAL.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: ONGOING EARLY DAY CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS COMPLICATE THE DETAILS OF THE FORECAST...ALONG WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR PEAK-HEATING COINCIDENT SHORTWAVE RIDGING OR AT LEAST NEUTRAL LARGE SCALE FORCING ESPECIALLY ACROSS EASTERN NEB/WESTERN IA. REGARDLESS...THE MOST LIKELY SCENARIO WILL BE FOR TSTM DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION BY LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS...IN VICINITY OF SURFACE LOW/EFFECTIVE FRONTAL TRIPLE POINT ACROSS WESTERN/NORTHERN KS...WITH UPSLOPE AIDED DEVELOPMENT ACROSS NORTHEAST CO/SOUTHEAST WY INTO SOUTHWEST NEB. SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE EARLY IN DEVELOPMENTAL CYCLES...WITH LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO POSSIBLE. ACTIVITY MAY GROW UPSCALE/DEVELOP EAST-NORTHEASTWARD WITH AN EVENING/PERHAPS OVERNIGHT DAMAGING WIND THREAT...AS A NOCTURNALLY STRENGTHENING LOW LEVEL JET IMPINGES ON THE QUASI-STATIONARY EFFECTIVE SURFACE FRONT.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: AHEAD OF THE APPROACHING NORTHERN ROCKIES UPPER TROUGH...TSTMS SHOULD STEADILY INCREASE/INTENSIFY WITHIN A MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS ACROSS THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON...INITIALLY ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHEAST/EASTERN MT AND NORTHEAST WY. LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE AS AMPLE INSTABILITY/RELATIVELY STRONG SOUTHWESTERLY FLOW ALOFT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS. DURING THE EVENING...AMPLE LARGE SCALE FORCING/RELATIVELY FAST FLOW ALOFT AND A WESTERN BRANCH OF THE LOW LEVEL JET WILL SUPPORT EASTWARD DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE DAKOTAS...WITH CONTINUED POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES/GULF COAST REGION
sections.text: STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS SHOULD AGAIN DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A MOIST AIRMASS/INSTABILITY AXIS ACROSS THE COASTAL CAROLINAS TO THE SOUTHEAST STATES/GULF COAST REGION. DOWNBURSTS/DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN RISK...WITH POTENTIAL FOR A FEW CLUSTERS TO EVOLVE/MOVE WSW ACROSS THE GULF COAST REGION DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING HOURS. ..GUYER/HURLBUT.. 06/21/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LITTLE CHANGE IN THE LARGE SCALE PATTERN EXPECTED THROUGH TUE. UPR RIDGE WILL PERSIST OVER THE SRN PLNS/OZARKS AS WRN MT UPR LOW AND TRAILING TROUGH SHEAR ENE INTO SRN SK/THE NRN RCKYS. SEASONABLY STRONG SW TO WLY FLOW WILL PREVAIL FROM THE RCKYS ACROSS THE NRN HALF OF THE PLNS INTO THE UPR MS VLY/GRT LKS...ON NW FRINGE OF THE RIDGE. A SERIES OF DISTURBANCES WITHIN THIS FLOW WILL MODULATE TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE REGION THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS INTO MID MS/LWR OH VLYS TODAY THROUGH EARLY TUE
sections.text: BROAD...MOIST...DIURNALLY-VARYING LLJ WILL PERSIST OVER THE PLNS AND NRN HALF OF THE MS VLY THROUGH TUE...BENEATH PERSISTENT EML. THIS WILL MAINTAIN/REGENERATE STRONG CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY ACROSS THE REGION...AND THE LIKELIHOOD FOR PERIODIC BOUTS OF STRONG TO SVR STORMS. AT THE MOMENT...UPR IMPULSE THAT MOVED ACROSS THE CNTRL RCKYS LATE YESTERDAY APPEARS TO BE OVER CNTRL NEB. THIS FEATURE MAY BE LOOSELY CONNECTED WITH MCS NOW OVER SE NEB. THE DISTURBANCE SHOULD CONTINUE ENE INTO THE UPR MS VLY BY EVE AND INTO MI EARLY TUE. THE UPR SYSTEM...IN CONJUNCTION WITH SFC HEATING...SHOULD SUPPORT MAINTENANCE OF MCS AS IT CONTINUES E INTO IA AND NRN MO. THESE FACTORS ALSO MAY SERVE TO STRENGTHEN STORMS...AND/OR FOSTER NEW DEVELOPMENT ON THE PERIPHERY OF EXISTING CONVECTION...IN ASSOCIATION WITH DOWNSTREAM MCS NOW OVER IL. THESE STORMS...WITH A THREAT FOR SVR WIND AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL...COULD AFFECT MUCH OF IND..WRN OH...AND POSSIBLY SRN LWR MI LATER TODAY. SHORTWAVE RIDGING SHOULD OCCUR THIS AFTN OVER THE CNTRL PLNS IN WAKE OF NEB IMPULSE. BUT COMBINATION OF STRONG SFC HEATING... DIURNALLY-ENHANCED MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW...AND THE APPROACH OF AN UPR DISTURBANCE NOW NEAR THE FOUR CORNERS SHOU

sections.title: NRN HI PLNS INTO DAKOTAS THIS AFTN THROUGH EARLY TUE
sections.text: SUBSTANTIAL LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT SHOULD OVERSPREAD CNTRL AND ERN MT LATER TODAY AS NRN RCKYS UPR LOW SHEARS ENE TOWARD SK. AMPLE MOISTURE /PW .75-1.00 INCH/ WILL REMAIN PRESENT IN CNTRL/ERN MT FOR STRONG STORMS. SFC HEATING SHOULD SUPPORT INTENSIFICATION/EXPANSION OF EXISTING TSTM AREA NOW IN NW MT. OTHER STORMS SHOULD FORM LATER TODAY ALONG LEE TROUGH IN E CNTRL/SE MT. 40+ KT DEEP WSWLY SHEAR WITH A SIZABLE LOW LVL DIRECTIONAL COMPONENT SHOULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO. THIS ACTIVITY MAY GROW INTO A FORWARD-PROPAGATING/BOW MCS BY EVE...WITH AN ENHANCED DMG WIND/HAIL THREAT THAT COULD CONTINUE INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS EARLY TUE.

sections.title: S ATLANTIC/NERN GULF CST/FL THIS AFTN
sections.text: STRONG/BRIEFLY SVR AFTN TSTMS SHOULD FORM ONCE AGAIN ALONG SFC TROUGH/CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDING FROM THE S ATLANTIC CSTL PLN TO THE FL PANHANDLE. OTHER STRONG STORMS SHOULD FORM ALONG SEA BREEZE BOUNDARIES OVER THE FL PENINSULA. HI PW AND STRONG SFC HEATING MAY AGAIN PROMOTE A FEW WET MICROBURSTS. SOME OF THE STORMS COULD EVOLVE INTO SMALL WSW-MOVING CLUSTERS OVER THE NERN GULF REGION DURING THE LATE AFTN/EVE. ..CORFIDI/GARNER.. 06/21/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: UPPER LOW LIFTING NEWD ACROSS MT TODAY WITH TROUGH TRAILING BACK ACROSS INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED IMPULSES CONTINUE TRACKING EWD ACROSS BROAD CENTRAL CONUS RIDGE WITH ONE OVER DAKOTAS THIS AM AND ANOTHER OVER IA TIED TO WEAKENING MCS. WHILE THE UPSLOPE HAS WEAKENED CENTRAL/NRN HIGH PLAINS SINCE SUNDAY...STEEP LAPSE RATES AND MDT SWLY MID/UPPER FLOW CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SCATTERED...MAINLY DIURNAL...SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT GIVEN THE AVAILABILITY OF MOISTURE/INSTABILITY.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AGAIN TODAY SCATTERED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN IN WEAK UPSLOPE FROM NERN CO TO ERN MT. STEEP LAPSE RATES REMAIN IN PLACE AND WHILE UPSLOPE WEAKER THAN SUNDAY...MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY MORE THAN SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. WHILE PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE LARGE HAIL GIVEN LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 8C/KM AND MLCAPE FROM 2-3K J/KG...ISOLATED TORNADOES WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. BOTH THE APPROACH OF THE MT UPPER LOW IN NRN PLAINS AND PRESENCE OF THE MID/UPPER LEVEL JET ACROSS CO WILL ENHANCE DEEP LAYER SHEAR. STORMS ONCE AGAIN EXPECTED TO DEVELOP UPSCALE BY THIS EVENING INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S AS THEY MOVE EWD INTO THE HIGH PLAINS WHERE DEEPER MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY WILL BE AVAILABLE. POTENTIAL FOR A MORE ORGANIZED WIND DAMAGE THREAT AS STORMS CONGEAL WITH THE DEVELOPMENT OF LARGE COLD POOLS. ADDITIONAL SEVERE DEVELOPMENT WILL BE LIKELY ALONG AND N OF THE CURRENT E/W OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS KS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AS IT LIFTS BACK TOWARD THE NEB BORDER. INITIALLY SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT...AGAIN LIKELY EVOLVING INTO A FORWARD PROPAGATING SQUALL LINE AS STORMS CONGEAL AND DEVELOP A COL

sections.title: MID MS TO OH VALLEY
sections.text: MCS OVER IA WITH TRAILING SQUALL LINE INTO NWRN MO WILL BE ENCOUNTERING THE POOL OF VERY MOIST AND BECOMING QUITE UNSTABLE AIR MASS FROM MO EWD INTO OH VALLEY. WITH STRONG HEATING...SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL REDEVELOP BY EARLY AFTERNOON AS THE CONVERGENCE ASSOCIATED WITH THE SQUALL LINE ENCOUNTERS MLCAPES OF 3-4K J/KG. WHILE THE MDT INSTABILITY AND RATHER STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT LARGE HAIL...PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE A MORE ORGANIZED WIND DAMAGE CONCERN AS THE STORMS EVOLVE INTO LINES/BOWS. ..HALES/STOPPKOTTE.. 06/21/2010

sections.title: UPDATE
sections.text: HAVE AMENDED TORNADO PROBABILITIES ACROSS THE MIDWEST COINCIDENT WITH TORNADO WATCH 369. A FEW BRIEF TORNADOES WILL ALSO REMAIN ACROSS NORTHWEST MN OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...WHERE MOIST AIRMASS/BACKED LOW LEVEL FLOW EXISTS AHEAD OF A SURFACE LOW.

sections.title: PREVIOUS 20Z DISCUSSION BELOW
sections.text: ...NRN PLAINS... FORMIDABLE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE OVER ERN ND WILL CONTINUE EWD INTO NWRN MN THIS EVENING. FEATURE MAY BE FOCUS FOR STRONG TO AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS/ISOLATED BRIEF TORNADO ALONG/W OF THE RED RIVER THROUGH EARLY EVENING. OTHERWISE...THE MAXIMUM IN SEVERE WIND/HAIL/TORNADO PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED WEST/SOUTH FROM ERN MT INTO SD /AS OPPOSED TO EARLIER E-W ORIENTATION/. EXPECTED DEVELOPMENT OVER ERN MT/ERN WY/SWRN SD SHOULD PROPAGATE INTO THE ESTABLISHED INSTABILITY AXIS RESIDING ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS INTO CNTRL SD OVERNIGHT.

sections.title: CENTRAL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: COLD POOL DYNAMICS FROM DECAYING MIDWEST MCS HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO NEW MULTICELL GROWTH OVER ERN KY AT MID-AFTERNOON. EXPECT STORMS TO PROPAGATE ALONG THE INSTABILITY AXIS INTO PARTS OF THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS WITH ISOLATED HAIL/STRONG WINDS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: A PAIR OF MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE VORTICITY MAXIMA CONTINUE ENE THROUGH THE UPPER MS VALLEY WITH THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING ALONG THE ERN/SRN PERIPHERIES. NARROW INSTABILITY AXIS HAS EVOLVED ALONG THE MS RIVER INTO NWRN/NCNTRL WI AMID 35 KTS OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR. SOME STORMS MAY PRODUCE SVR HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. ...REMAINDER OF THE FORECAST DISCUSSION REMAINS VALID FOR THE CENTRAL PLAINS AND THE MIDDLE MS/OH VALLEYS... ..SELECT A FORECASTER.. 06/21/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1119 AM CDT MON JUN 21 2010/

sections.text: AS A SHORTWAVE TROUGH ADVANCES EASTWARD OVER WI...MULTI-FACETED SEVERE EPISODE WILL CONTINUE ACROSS THE MIDWEST/LAKE MI VICINITY THIS EVENING...INCLUDING PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN IA/NORTHERN MO INTO NORTHERN/CENTRAL PORTIONS OF IL/INDIANA AND SOUTHERN WI...EASTWARD TO LOWER MI/WESTERN OH. SUPERCELLS WITH TORNADOES WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE MAINLY ACROSS THE NORTHERN HALF OF IL INTO NORTHWEST INDIANA/SOUTHERN WI THROUGH MID EVENING...BUT OTHERWISE DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BECOME MORE OF A CONCERN TONIGHT.

AIDED BY A STRENGTHENING SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL JET...AND A SEVERE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE WELL THROUGH THE NIGHT ESPECIALLY ACROSS NORTHERN KS/SOUTHERN NEB ALONG/JUST NORTH OF AN EFFECTIVE SURFACE FRONT. A TORNADO OR TWO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE...BUT DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL SHOULD INCREASE TONIGHT ASIDE FROM LARGE HAIL.

AMPLE LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT/ELEVATED MOISTURE TRANSPORT SHOULD SUPPORT UPSCALE GROWTH/EAST-SOUTHEAST FORWARD PROPAGATION OF ONE OR MORE MCS/S INTO SD/ADJACENT SOUTHERN ND LATE THIS EVENING/OVERNIGHT...WITH DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL INCREASING. ..GUYER.. 06/22/2010
